runners_data.name: Road To Wembley

runners_data.name: Jet Renegade
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 138-day break faces a pace scenario that doesn't favour his running style

races.paceDynamic: Road To Wembley, Maskarvel, and Phantom Gold will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with all three having confirmed leading tendencies and no natural hold-up horses likely to dictate from the front. Road To Wembley brings the strongest form and will likely take them along at a searching pace, while Maskarvel and Phantom Gold ensure no let-up through the middle stages. The strong early pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over this testing 2m1f trip. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina reserves who can track the pace and strike late, putting the pure hold-up horses at a significant disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Tracker
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley or Maskarvel maintain a genuine gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The searching pace plays to horses that can sit handy and have the class to quicken when others tire. Into Battle's prominent style and strong course record make him perfectly positioned to benefit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley gets loose on the lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: His superior class and recent good form allow him to dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last. Maskarvel could also profit if allowed to bowl along in front without serious pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back to the field
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses Red Nile and Jet Renegade get their chance to close from off the pace. Red Nile's class could shine through if the race becomes tactical in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran finds his old sparkle and outbattles younger rivals
scenarios.body: His recent Hexham win suggests a return to form and the strong pace could suit his front-running style perfectly. The age and experience factor could prove decisive in a finish between tired horses.

watchPoints.text: Road To Wembley breaking clear approaching the last flight if allowed to control the tempo unchallenged
Into Battle tracking the leaders turning for home as his prominent style is perfectly suited to this pace shape
Red Nile's jumping and position approaching halfway after such a long absence
Maskarvel and Phantom Gold disputing the early lead and whether either can sustain the gallop
The pace through the first mile as three confirmed front runners could create an unsustainable gallop

races.paceDynamic: I C U In My Dreams will control the pace from the front with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable tempo that suits her style. With most runners preferring to race mid-pack or hold up positions (My Chiquita, Roaring Home, Mermaids Cave, Golden Glance), the early pace will be comfortable rather than searching. The lack of genuine pace pressure means hold-up horses will face the tactical challenge of making ground from off a steady gallop over 2m4f. This race shape clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace and avoid traffic problems in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If I C U In My Dreams dictates a comfortable tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows front-runners to control their effort and kick when it matters. Hold-up horses struggle to make significant ground from off the steady gallop over this extended trip.
winners: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Holders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and collapses in the straight
scenarios.body: A crawling pace sets up a sprint finish where hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks. Quality closers with proven form get their ideal scenario despite the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent racers press I C U In My Dreams creating honest gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses racing in the first four positions. Those tracking the pace can strike at the right moment while hold-up horses are left with too much to do.
others: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Breakdown Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If positioning problems or interference create chaos in the straight
scenarios.body: Poor positioning or traffic issues allow unconsidered runners to find daylight and gaps. Form horses get stopped in their run while lesser fancied animals find clear passages to the line.
winners: I C U In My Dreams

races.paceDynamic: The Flier Begley will be the undisputed pace-setter from the start, likely taking them along at a steady rhythm without serious pressure from the prominent runners. Parisencore, Southoftheborder, Bleu d'Enfer, Fringill Dike and Breizh River will all settle in behind but none are aggressive early pace-forcers, meaning The Flier Begley can dictate terms. With three hold-up horses (Coastguard Station, My Noble Lord, Genois) needing the pace to collapse, but The Flier Begley likely getting an easy lead, this sets up perfectly for the front-runner and prominent racers who can track the pace without getting into a speed duel. The race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Flier Begley gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old can use his class edge (OR 130) to control from the front while the prominent pack fails to apply enough pressure. His stamina and tactical position prove decisive as the hold-up horses find too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners tracks The Flier Begley perfectly and has more left in the tank
scenarios.body: The pace-setter does the donkey work but fades in the final furlong, allowing a well-positioned prominent runner to strike. Southoftheborder or Breizh River are best placed to capitalize from ideal tracking positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If The Flier Begley goes too fast early or the prominent pack gets into a speed battle
scenarios.body: The pace collapses dramatically in the final half-mile, setting up a late charge from the back. My Noble Lord's age advantage (5-year-old) could tell against these older rivals in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If The Flier Begley stops suddenly and the prominent runners also empty out early
scenarios.body: Complete pace collapse creates a messy finish where stamina and class matter most. The race becomes a lottery with several horses hitting the front in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: Watch The Flier Begley's early pace - if he goes too fast trying to build a big lead, it opens the door for the hold-up horses.
Monitor how aggressively the prominent pack of Southoftheborder, Parisencore and Breizh River track the leader - any speed battle hurts their chances.
Watch My Noble Lord's position turning for home - if he's still last with two to go, his young legs could power him home.
Check Breizh River's jumping rhythm early - he's the form horse among the prominent runners and could track into contention.
Watch for any early mistakes from the favourites as this compact field won't give much room for error over Aintree's fences.

races.paceDynamic: Fingal's Hill will take them along from the front with little pressure early, setting a controlled tempo that suits his front-running style. The prominent runners Brewin'upastorm, Static, Lightningupourdays and Luttrell Lad will track him closely, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Rambo T, Smokeringinthedark, El Galactico, Ike Sport, Last Kingdom and Break Point will be held up in the pack. With only one confirmed pace-setter and multiple closers, this will develop into a sprint finish where stamina and tactical positioning become crucial. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, rather than the hold-up horses who may find too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled throughout with Fingal's Hill setting modest fractions
scenarios.body: The trackers get first run on the leader and have enough left to hold off the closers who find the gap too big to bridge. Those positioned prominently but not committed to the lead get the perfect trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too hard trying to collar Fingal's Hill turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing a well-ridden closer to sweep through tired horses. The best of the hold-up brigade with tactical speed benefits most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Fingal's Hill gets an uncontested lead and the field hesitates to challenge early enough
scenarios.body: He builds an unassailable advantage that the pack can't peg back despite their late surge. His stamina and course knowledge prove decisive when given too much rope.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners commit simultaneously in a messy mid-race battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical muddle with no clear pace narrative, allowing an outsider with the right positioning to steal through. Jockey skill becomes paramount in the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Fingal's Hill getting too much rope on the lead - if nobody challenges him early he could steal this

races.paceDynamic: Bumpy Evans and Taxus Baccata will duel from the start, with Taxus Baccata likely to concede early given his softer recent form, leaving Bumpy Evans to dictate honest fractions over 3m1f. The prominent brigade of Calimystic, Erne River, Loughderg Rocco and My Bobby Dazzler creates serious traffic dangers jumping the Canal Turn and Valentine's second time, especially with four runners wanting prime tracking positions behind the leaders. Hold-up horses Regarde, Jacks Parrot, Fortunedefortunata and Aboutdamntime face a stamina test if the pace becomes searching, but benefit if the prominent congestion causes interference. This race shape clearly favours horses that can secure clean jumping room early - either the lone leader Bumpy Evans or the strongest hold-up performers who can navigate trouble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bumpy Evans Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans gets an easy lead after Taxus Baccata drops back early.
scenarios.body: The Kerry Lee runner can dictate comfortable fractions and kick clear approaching the second-last, exploiting his class edge over this field. His fresh appearance after just 7 days and proven stamina reserves make him hard to peg back in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet causes significant interference 2-3 out, opening gaps for closers.
scenarios.body: Aboutdamntime and Regarde can exploit their superior finishing kicks when others are compromised by traffic problems. Jamie Snowden's charge Regarde particularly benefits with his strong recent form and proven ability to find extra gear late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Calimystic Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Henderson's runner gets first run on the field approaching the second-last.
scenarios.body: The Grade 1 winner's superior class shines through despite the prominent traffic concerns, with Nico de Boinville timing his challenge perfectly. His 69-day break becomes an asset rather than concern given his proven ability fresh.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Bumpy Evans and Taxus Baccata fade dramatically before halfway.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Jacks Parrot's superior finishing speed and lighter weight prove decisive over the extended trip. Oliver Greenall's stable form gives both Jacks Parrot and Aboutdamntime significant chances in a muddling affair.

watchPoints.text: Erne River and Loughderg Rocco risk getting trapped behind traffic approaching Canal Turn second time with nowhere to go.
Taxus Baccata may fold tamely if Bumpy Evans puts pressure on early, leaving the leader with an uncontested advantage.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Spartan Times gets an easy lead with Grey Skies struggling

races.paceDynamic: Disguisedlimit will be the sole leader in a race light on early pace, with Emerald Time, Mr Lincoln and Roarin' Success settling prominent but unlikely to challenge for the early lead. The lack of pace pressure should allow Disguisedlimit to dictate terms and potentially steal a march on a field packed with hold-up horses including Guet Apens, Caelan, Inappropriate and Maple. With seven of ten runners preferring to come from behind, this becomes a tactical affair where the front-runner holds a significant positional advantage. This race shape strongly favours the leader and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will face the massed ranks of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses stay closer to the pace and kick before the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: Emerald Time or Roarin' Success avoid the traffic chaos behind and get first run on Disguisedlimit in the straight. Their tactical position proves decisive in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Disguisedlimit stops quickly and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The early leader folds tamely, turning it into a cavalry charge where one of the unfancied hold-up horses like Mojo Ego benefits from the chaos. Fresh legs and a good jump at the last prove crucial.
